skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the concept of operations management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the basic concepts related to operations and operations management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the role and development process of operations management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the role and development process of operations management.
Students will be able to forecast product demand using various methods.
Students will learn about product design and its importance in operations management.
Students will learn how to plan capacity effectively.
Students will understand the concept and role of enterprise positioning.
Students will learn about production floor layout and its importance.
Students will understand strategic and operational management concepts.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Making decisions on practical operational issues
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to make decisions and handle practical operational issues.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Combining experience, knowledge, and tools to solve operational management problems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to combine their experience, knowledge, and tools to solve operational management problems.
Students will be able to analyze case studies presented in the textbook.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing real-world examples in operations management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze real-world examples in operations management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying different methods in operations management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to apply different methods in operations management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Solving exercises related to operations management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to solve exercises related to operations management.
